title: Quickler: report writing, finally fixed
summary: A 2 minute 19 second tour of Quickler: set up a Check, do a site safety inspection on WhatsApp, and see the finished Record.
description: Inspection apps keep you at your desk for hours. Quickler is built for the in-person visit: you walk around, send photos and voice notes, and Quickler handles the processing. This short tour shows setting up a Check, a site safety inspection on WhatsApp, and the finished Record. 14 days free, no card needed.
chapters: A site safety inspection on WhatsApp
The Record and the to-do list
Branding, your team and a free trial
transcript: Report writing is finally fixed. Inspection apps keep you at your desk for hours, until Quickler came along. I'm going to show you how we fixed it. It's very simple and it will only take a few minutes.
Quickler is all about the in-person visit. You walk around, you send photos and send voice notes. And Quickler handles the processing of all the information.

Setting up is quick. Add a check here, say what you'd like checked and press continue. Or upload a file you already use, and we'll extract the questions. You can also schedule it and Quickler will chase anyone who forgets.
Here is a site safety inspection on WhatsApp. We'll say what we're checking and get talking.
[A voice note plays.]

You can send voice notes and photos in any order. Just like you would to a colleague. After each message, Quickler shows what's still to cover so you never lose your place. Anything you don't mention counts as okay. So you never have to tick 40 boxes later. And when you're finished, you just say done. Quickler then sorts all your photos and words into the right places, ready for you to approve.

This brings us to the record. If you don't say something, we don't make it up. If you do, we don't lose it. Every fault goes into the to-do list at the top. So issues are flagged to the reader without them having to hunt through the report. From there, they can be copied and pasted to wherever they're needed.

Don't like the way something is written? Click on any answer and type over it. Has a photo been misrouted? Drag it to wherever you like. Notice something at the end of the visit? Just say it on WhatsApp.

Sharing the report is very easy using the shareable link. Do you need it in Word, Excel, or a PDF? You can do that too. What about branding? You can get that as well. Can you add your whole team? Yes, just like this. And it does all of this as well.
Now there's plenty more, but honestly, it's way better to try for yourself. 14 days free at quickler.co. No card needed.

summary: Tick Records on a Check's Records page and press Combine records to make one combined Record that lists exactly what it was made from.

chapters: Each photo once, and what it was made from
transcript: Imagine you have a week's worth of inspections, or one big site that took several days to get round. Either way, you'll want one record that brings them all together.
On the Check's Record page, press Combine. Then click the records you want, by subject or by person. Take a group, and everything in it comes as well.
Quickler then makes them into one combined record, kept under Combined Records on that page.
If the records are all from the same place, like a daily check of one building, the latest answer counts.
If they're from different places, like separate buildings on a big site, the worst answer is the one that's flagged, and the fault always says which place it came from.
Any photo that turns up more than once appears only once, and the combined record lists exactly what it was made from, so you can always find the originals.
So, whether you need one report for a large site, or one for the whole week, It only takes a few clicks. Quickler has you covered.

chapters: Not on site: open the map full screen
transcript: For sharing your location on an Android device on WhatsApp, the steps are pretty simple.
First, you must press the paperclip down at the bottom of your screen.
We'll then open a menu like this, where we select Location.
This will then open the map as you see before you.
If you're on a site right now, press Send your current location.
If you are not at this site, but you'd like to select that site address, you can press the button in the top left that expands the map to full screen.
From there, you'll see a red pin in the centre of your screen, and you can choose to move that wherever you need.
Once you have selected where your pin would be, you can press on the pin and press Send this location.
Quickler will use that pin you have sent to get the weather and your address from that location.

transcript: Sometimes you may need to send a signature as part of your report. With Quickler, you can do that through Telegram or WhatsApp by using a photo. I'll show you how.
First, press the camera button on the chat and then take a photo of something plain.
This could be your hand or a piece of clothing or the ground or something like that.
I'm taking a photo of the desk in this situation. Then press the photo button.
Once you've done that, select the pen. You'll see on WhatsApp the pen is in the top right.
You can choose any colour you want. I'm going to go for bright green.
And then write your signature.
Once you've done that, press done. I should say the rotation that you send your signature in doesn't matter because Quickler will correct that for you. You don't have to say anything.
It will be recognised as a signature. It'll be recognised as writing. And you can go on with your check as normal. Or if you're just coming to the end, you can say done as usual.

transcript: Some questions have a list of fixed answers, like the location or type of work, or it could be a fire risk assessment that might be graded as trivial, tolerable and so on.
To do that we can set the answer type to graded, then choose the words that people will use.
You can pick a list that you already use, if you have one, or press Add word and type your own.
Add the best answer first and the worst answer last.
Click any word to write what it means. That sentence then goes to the Record.
If you leave a word's meaning empty, Quickler will write one for you shortly after.
The cross beside a word gets rid of it. Or perhaps you'd rather a grade with a number. Then in that case you can choose numbers and set the highest number.
On site, nobody will see this list. They'll just say it in their own words and Quickler will pick the matching word, that is the matching grade.
You can open the key at the bottom of the Record to see every word and what it means. You can change a word's sentence here and it changes on every Record of that Check.
The key is printed on your PDF as well, so readers can see it too. Or hide it by pressing Hide. You can press it again to show it.

chapters: Archived photos wait at the bottom
transcript: Every Check has a Records page, with everything it has ever collected.
Once you have enough Records, filters appear: today, 7 days, 30 days and so on.
You can switch between By title and By user to see the same Records another way.
You can click a title and you see its whole history, one Record after another.
You can press Download all and choose a file type for every Record at once. Quickler packs them into a zip with each Record in its own folder.
You can also open any Record and add more photos, or drag them to where they belong, like this.

When you click on a photo, you can turn it like this. You can change its caption here and type what you like, like this. Or you can copy it by clicking here, like this. Or you can archive it if you don't want it on the Record.
An archived photo waits all the way down here at the bottom. You can bring it back by clicking here.
A document sent during the walk, much like a PDF, is kept with the Record too, down here.
Press Changes and time taken to see how long the walk and edits took. Every change sits under its question with who made it and when.
To delete a Record, press Delete, then confirm in the box that it opens. You get about 10 seconds to press Undo and the Record comes straight back.
Even after that, a Record is kept for 30 days after being deleted, so if you need it, just ask us.

title: Quickler: your account
summary: Everything for your account lives on the Settings page: your plan and next bill, past invoices, cancelling in two clicks, signing in by password, link or code, and adding contacts by email, phone number or both.
description: How your Quickler account works. Everything lives on the Settings page. Press Billing to see your plan, the phone numbers this month and your next bill, download any past invoice as a PDF, and cancel in two clicks. Sign in with email and password, a sign-in link that lasts a day or a six-digit code that works for 15 minutes. Add contacts with an email, a phone number or both. Everyone who joins by email joins as an admin, and Quickler asks you to confirm the cost before a new number takes you above your plan.
chapters: Plan, phone numbers and next bill
Joining by email makes an admin
transcript: Everything for your account lives on the Settings page. Press Billing and it opens right there, with no new page.
You can see your plan, the phone numbers this month and your next bill.
Every payment collected appears under past invoices, and this is also emailed to you. You can download a copy as a PDF for any invoice or of your subscription confirmation.
Cancelling takes just two clicks, so it can never happen by accident. If you cancel, your Checks keep running until the end of the paid period.

To sign in, enter your email and password, or ask for a sign-in link. The link lasts one day. If you need it, you can ask for a six-digit code instead. A code works for 15 minutes, then it stops working.
In Settings, you can set a password of at least 10 characters.
Each contact can have an email, a phone number, or both. Just enter an email and Quickler will invite them to your account. Everyone who joins via email joins as an admin, so choose carefully.

If you add a phone number, that's how you can do Checks on WhatsApp and Telegram. With only a phone number, they never need to log in. With only an email, they never need to do a Check on their phone.
If a new number takes you above your plan, Quickler will ask you to confirm the extra cost first.
